name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian attacks kill 6 and injure 25 to 27 Nov; 155 drones overnight cut power in six regions and hit railways
state: Regional authorities said Russian attacks killed six people and injured 25 across Ukraine in the day to 27 Nov; the air force said Russia launched 155 drones overnight, 110 of them downed, and strikes on substations cut power in six oblasts (Kyiv Independent). Prime Minister Koretskyi said railway and energy sites were hit in nine regions (Ukrinform). This follows 10 killed and 58 injured on 25–26 Nov; sustained mass strikes on energy keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy infrastructure can affect European power and gas markets.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on energy infrastructure across regions = Alert

sources.title: Kyiv Independent — Russian attacks kill 6, injure 25 across Ukraine over past day, power outages across 6 oblasts
Ukrinform — Russian strikes hit railways and energy infrastructure in nine Ukrainian regions overnight

why: Europe's largest war since 1945 shapes European security, energy, food exports and defence budgets.
drivers: Front-line offensives, strike campaigns on energy, Western aid, negotiations, nuclear plant safety.

rubric.alert: Significant escalation — major new offensive, mass-casualty strikes, a nuclear-plant safety incident, or new state involvement.
rubric.watch: Active war at sustained intensity, or a ceasefire under strain.
